title: My Thoughts on Chance Theater’s production of Fancy Nancy Splendiferous Christmas
transcript: Today's Show is Fancy Nancy splend differ Christmas the musical okay I'm in Los Angeles right now I came down to see a production of this show in Anaheim at The Chance theater now my experience with this show well I'm one of the writers on it so I can't really be objective and do a normal boarding confused review of the show but I do want to talk about the process of writing a show for those of you who are interested in that so Fancy Nancy splend Christmas was written 10 years years ago for Vital Theater Company in New York City we were hired last minute to write the show we only had two weeks before rehearsals started for this show and four weeks before it opened this was written in a whirlwind of just writing a new song every other day and putting the thing up on its feet it's kind of a good way to write a show because there was no time to second guess our instincts and I have to say this is one of the favorite shows I've written now is it perfect no not a perfect
